scope: Frozen23-input Phase1 incident-response logical/source definition and future synthetic rehearsal scenarios, cycle0

findings.issue: The separate individual communication requirement lists clear language/protective advice, contact, consequences and measures but omits describing the nature of the personal-data breach. GDPR34(2) and EDPB9/2022 paragraphs85-86 expressly require this description. Including nature in the preceding authority-notification clause does not clearly bind the individual notice, so a future notice could follow the listed items while omitting mandatory context.
findings.requested_correction: Explicitly require the individual communication to describe the nature of the breach in clear/plain language, retaining the required contact, likely consequences, measures and useful protective advice. No notification authority or live communication follows.

other_assessment: Awareness/first report/interruption are distinct; reasonable certainty, prompt triage and no forensics/exfiltration grace period match EDPB31-40. Processor without-undue-delay controller reporting is separate from controller72-elapsed-hour/undue-delay awareness clock; controller risk versus high-risk individual thresholds, phased/late reporting, assessed34(3) safeguards/equally effective public alternative and affected-state nonEEA routing match supplied sources. Non-notification records, separate minimized forensic/purpose handling, DE21, no automatic grants, unchanged D076 alias ownership/D068 deferral and I/R/V/F versus awareness hold. Twelve future scenarios retain those duties and distinguish simulation, unknown delivery and actual boundaries. No other scoped finding.
limits: Saved-source consistency only, not jurisdiction-specific counsel, legal clearance, policy adoption, new role/grant/endpoint, actual mailbox/authority communication, incident handling, delivery, restore, runtime/security/load proof, rehearsal execution or integrated/founder acceptance. No source capture/prepare script execution, network, installs, app/model/dependency/account/Figma/Git/notification/restore changes.
